newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIANS HELD UP BY RAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIANS HELD UP BY RAIN.

text.p: Rain held up the start of the Australian touring team's three-day match against Nottinghamshire at Trent Bridge on Wednesday.
Overnight rain left the outfield saturated and although the players were able to practise before the scheduled start, another heavy shower ruled out a prompt beginning.
The Australians are particularly anxious to give pace bowler Paul Reiffel as much match play as possible before next week's Lord's test following his arrival on Tuesday.
Reiffel has been added to the tour party because of injuries to fellow pacemen Jason Gillespie (hamstring) and Andy Bichel (back trouble).
